description.zh:
是否解绑实例上全部的标签。当请求中未设置TagKey.N时，该参数才有效。取值范围：

- true
- false

默认值：false
description.en:
Specifies whether to unbind all tags from the instance. This parameter takes effect only when TagKey.N is not specified in the request. Valid values:

- true
- false

Default value: false.
The region ID of the instance.
The instance ID. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

- `ALIYUN::GPDB::INSTANCE`：弹性模式实例。
description.en:
The resource type. Valid values:
- `instance`: reserved mode instance.

description.en: The tag key of the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

title.zh: 解绑 Supabase 项目标签
title.en: Unbind tags from a supabase project

descriptions.zh: 此接口为查询Supabase实例详情
descriptions.en: Queries the details of a Supabase instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb untag-supabase-project --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type instance --all false --resource-id gp-2zev51nt170740000 --tag-key TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb UntagSupabaseProject --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'gp-2zev51nt170740000' --TagKey.1 TestKey --ResourceType instance --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
